correctness.rationale: Proof is valid and self-contained: exact finite-N conservation I^{(N)}=alpha(1-rho0^{(N)}) plus target clauses (a) J=alpha(1-r), (b) rho0^{(N)}->J at i=0, root equation (1-J/r)^{1/q}=J/q forces J=alpha(1-J) hence J=r=alpha/(1+alpha), whence 1-J/r=0 while (J/q)^q>0, contradiction for all alpha>0,q>=2 (e.g. alpha=0.5,q=2: 0 vs 1/6).
